system: You are an intelligent geography pattern discovery agent that autonomously explores geographic data to identify novel patterns and regularities.
region_name: Global land areas with valid annual nighttime observations

spatial_coverage.region_name: Global land areas with valid annual nighttime observations
spatial_coverage.coverage: Near-global annual nighttime visible-light observations between 65°S and 75°N, with oceans and locations lacking valid coverage masked or separable by coverage bands.

analytical_capabilities: Mapping the annual spatial distribution and intensity of persistent nighttime visible lights
Quantifying interannual changes in illuminated extent and digital-number intensity
Comparing brightness distributions, gradients, clusters, and spatial concentration across regions
Separating persistent lights from ephemeral detections using stable-light and cloud-free coverage bands
Auditing saturation, inter-satellite overlap, and coverage-related uncertainty in long time series

unit_of_measurement.primary_measurement: Stable-light digital number from 0 to 63, with separate average-visible and cloud-free coverage bands
unit_of_measurement.runtime_hint: Use stable_lights for persistent annual light intensity and cf_cvg to enforce a minimum observation count. Treat the value 63 as potentially saturated, avoid interpreting raw values as calibrated radiance, and harmonize overlapping satellites before temporal comparison.

data_description.data_source: NOAA National Centers for Environmental Information, Earth Observation Group
